name: World Beast - Eclypse
text:
3+ 'World Servant' Monsters
When this card is link summoned this cards ATK becomes equil to the combined total of all monster cards this card points too. Once Per Turn: You can destroy one monster card this card points to. Once Per Game (Quick Effect): When your opponent would activate a Spell/Trap card you can banish one monster card this card points to. if you do Negate the activation and destroy the card.
